Rounds

The bloons in every round and values computed from the bloon models. RBE is the total HP of all layers. $ from pops counts 1 $ per layer popped, times the round's income multiplier (DefaultIncomeSet). The end of round bonus is 100 + the round number (BonusCashPerRoundModModel). MOAB-class HP grows in late rounds; base values are shown here.

Data: 57.4 (Mod Helper export, 2026-11-04)
